query:
SELECT
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('served', 'voided')) AS "still_out!",
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'voided') AS "countable!",
            coalesce(sum(line_total) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'voided'), 0) AS "raw_subtotal!"
        FROM order_lines
        WHERE bill_id = $1
